title: Cmd-N, then Ctrl-` in the new workspace, then type: the line runs in the new terminal at once
why: STATUS 1729: in 6 of 14 rounds of focus-switch-corner-drag the line typed after Cmd-N then Ctrl-` got debug.key handled_by app (the router's stale last action newSurface) and did not run. Cmd-N's New Tab key hold owns every key of its window until its page reports ready (at most 4 s); a Ctrl-` before that hid the page and the hold kept the keys typed for the new terminal. The last check records the New Tab hold's log (debug.focus new_tab_key_log): 'hold key' on the base, 'release: a creation took the keys' on the fix, when the page was not ready at the Ctrl-` (the hold path).
source: P0 CMD-N CTRL-BACKTICK FIRST KEY (STATUS 1729), agent a539d1ff2011e6d9e
